name: reporter_cluster_pie_handbook
description: Complete handbook test for Pie family reporters: pie (L1-L8), cs_pie (L1-L6). 14 layouts total, each in its own category.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Pie Family Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = market_data_source()()
open_px = src.o
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v
ts = index()

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
sma_50 = sma(period=50)(close)
sma_200 = sma(period=200)(close)
rsi_14 = rsi(period=14)(close)
ones = close / close

# Date components
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
day_of_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(ts)

# Gap calculation
gap = (open_px - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)

# Range calculation
range_pct = (high - low) / close

# ========================================================================
# PIE (per-asset) — L1 through L8
# ========================================================================

# L1: Up vs Down Day Distribution — Basic 2-slice pie
up_down_label = 'Up' if daily_ret > 0 else 'Down'
pie(
    title='L1: Up vs Down Day Distribution',
    category='01 pie L1: Basic 2-Slice'
)(up_down_label, ones)

# L2: Return Size Distribution — 4-way nested ternary
size_label = 'Big Up' if daily_ret > 0.01 else ('Small Up' if daily_ret > 0 else ('Small Down' if daily_ret > -0.01 else 'Big Down'))
pie(
    title='L2: Return Size Distribution',
    category='02 pie L2: 4-Way Ternary'
)(size_label, ones)

# L3: Volume Share by Quarter (Donut)
q_label = 'Q1' if month_num <= 3 else ('Q2' if month_num <= 6 else ('Q3' if month_num <= 9 else 'Q4'))
pie(
    title='L3: Volume Share by Quarter',
    category='03 pie L3: Donut',
    inner_size=50
)(q_label, volume)

# L4: Gap Direction Distribution
gap_label = 'Gap Up' if gap > 0.001 else ('Gap Down' if gap < -0.001 else 'Flat')
pie(
    title='L4: Gap Direction Distribution',
    category='04 pie L4: Custom Colors',
    colors=[Color.Green, Color.Gray, Color.Red]
)(gap_label, ones)

# L5: RSI Regime Distribution
rsi_label = 'Oversold' if rsi_14 < 30 else ('Overbought' if rsi_14 > 70 else 'Neutral')
pie(
    title='L5: RSI Regime Distribution',
    category='05 pie L5: Large Donut',
    inner_size=70
)(rsi_label, ones)

# L6: Volume by Day of Week — 5-way nested ternary
dow_label = 'Mon' if day_of_week == 0 else ('Tue' if day_of_week == 1 else ('Wed' if day_of_week == 2 else ('Thu' if day_of_week == 3 else 'Fri')))
pie(
    title='L6: Volume by Day of Week',
    category='06 pie L6: 5-Way Ternary'
)(dow_label, volume)

# L7: Trend Regime Breakdown — Compound boolean via multiplication
above_sma50 = 1.0 if close > sma_50 else 0.0
sma50_above_200 = 1.0 if sma_50 > sma_200 else 0.0
uptrend_flag = above_sma50 * sma50_above_200
below_sma50 = 1.0 if close < sma_50 else 0.0
sma50_below_200 = 1.0 if sma_50 < sma_200 else 0.0
downtrend_flag = below_sma50 * sma50_below_200
trend_label = 'Uptrend' if uptrend_flag > 0.5 else ('Downtrend' if downtrend_flag > 0.5 else 'Consolidation')
pie(
    title='L7: Trend Regime Breakdown',
    category='07 pie L7: Boolean Logic',
    colors=[Color.Green, Color.Red, Color.Amber]
)(trend_label, ones)

# L8: Daily Range Classification
range_label = 'Low Vol' if range_pct < 0.01 else ('High Vol' if range_pct > 0.025 else 'Medium Vol')
pie(
    title='L8: Daily Range Classification',
    category='08 pie L8: Order + Donut',
    order=5,
    inner_size=40
)(range_label, ones)

# ========================================================================
# CS_PIE (cross-sectional) — L1 through L6
# ========================================================================

# CS L1: Price-Weighted Allocation — Default agg (Last)
cs_pie(
    title='CS L1: Price-Weighted Allocation',
    category='09 cs_pie L1: Default Agg'
)(close)

# CS L2: Total Return Contribution (Donut)
cs_pie(
    title='CS L2: Total Return Contribution',
    category='10 cs_pie L2: Sum + Donut',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    inner_size=60
)(daily_ret)

# CS L3: Volatility Contribution
cs_pie(
    title='CS L3: Volatility Contribution',
    category='11 cs_pie L3: Std + Colors',
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Indigo, Color.Gray]
)(daily_ret)

# CS L4: Average Volume Share
cs_pie(
    title='CS L4: Average Volume Share',
    category='12 cs_pie L4: Mean',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean
)(volume)

# CS L5: Worst Return by Asset
cs_pie(
    title='CS L5: Worst Return by Asset',
    category='13 cs_pie L5: Min + Colors',
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    colors=[Color.Red, Color.Orange, Color.Amber],
    inner_size=55
)(daily_ret)

# CS L6: Top 2 Assets by Volume
cs_pie(
    title='CS L6: Top 2 Assets by Volume',
    category='14 cs_pie L6: Max Assets',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    max_assets=2,
    order=-1
)(volume)

# ========================================================================
# CS_PIE — AGG DIVERSITY (13 values)
# ========================================================================

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Max,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Max'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Median'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Count'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.First,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=First'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.All,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=All'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Any,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Any'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=CountDistinct'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Kurtosis'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Mode'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Product'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Quantile,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Quantile'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Skew,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Skew'
)(close)

cs_pie(
    agg=AggregationType.Var,
    category='AD cs_pie agg=Var'
)(close)
